name: crosstalk
description: Message colleagues' Claude Code sessions through your organization's crosstalk relay. You approve every message in both directions.

relayUrl.title: Relay URL
relayUrl.description: Your organization's crosstalk relay, e.g. https://crosstalk.example.com. Plain http is accepted only for localhost.

token.title: Your crosstalk token
token.description: The personal token your relay admin gave you (starts with ct_). Kept in secure storage.

autoDeliverFrom.title: Deliver straight to Claude from
autoDeliverFrom.description: Colleagues whose messages go to Claude at once as a plain prompt, exactly their text, as if you typed it: handles separated by commas (e.g. "medyas, sara"), or * for anyone on the relay. Their messages skip approval and Claude acts on them with your permissions. Others still wait in the inbox.

approveOutgoing.title: Approve messages Claude writes
approveOutgoing.description: "on": a message Claude composes waits in the crosstalk pane until you press Send. "off": Claude's messages go out at once. Messages you type with /dm always go at once.

longPollSeconds.title: Inbox long-poll (seconds)
longPollSeconds.description: How long each inbox request waits on the relay for new messages (1-25).
